---
title: "Cyber Macro Impact Pilot"
format: html
---

## Research question

How are country-level cyber readiness and incident intensity associated with macro outcomes such as GDP growth, productivity, investment, and employment?

## Data

This report expects a processed country-year panel at `data_processed/panel_country_year.parquet`.

## Baseline model

We use country and year fixed-effects models with lagged cyber variables and clustered standard errors at country level.

## Outputs

- One headline regression table
- One robustness table
- Two figures (structural and dynamic)

## Notes

This is an MVP scaffold. Populate scripts in `R/` to produce fully reproducible outputs.
